original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-h1-extensions}
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space. Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a sheaf of
$\mathcal{O}_X$-modules. There is a canonical bijection
$$
\Ext^1_{\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{O}_X)}(\mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{F})
\longrightarrow
H^1(X, \mathcal{F})
$$
which associates to the extension
$$
0 \to \mathcal{F} \to \mathcal{E} \to \mathcal{O}_X \to 0
$$
the image of $1 \in \Gamma(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ in $H^1(X, \mathcal{F})$.

hypotheses: $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ is a ringed space; $\mathcal F$ is a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules.
conclusions: The canonical bijection $\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)}(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal F)\longrightarrow H^1(X,\mathcal F)$ sends an extension $0\to\mathcal F\to\mathcal E\to\mathcal O_X\to0$ to the connecting image of $1\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$.
